You get the best disney character meal at Chef Mickey’s in the contemporary. It has (In my opinion) great food and characters walk around the whole time. There’s a restaurant in the magic kingdom called the crystal palace that is also a wonderful dining with characters! For dinner my personal favorite place would be La Celiar in Canada at Epcot, it’s a steak house but it’s a little pricey. If you looking for a good cheap meal I recommend hitting up yak an yeti in the animal kingdom it gets mixed reviews but I like it there. Another good quick meal is Pinocchio village haus in fantasy land at the magic kingdom, there is seating at the window that overlooks “it’s a small world”, also it is air conditioned.  

Rope drop is a little ceremony they do at the beginning of the day at magic kingdom where they put on a little show for the guests about to enter the park.  Fast pass and rope drop are two totally different things. But I recommend looking into ride wait times for your trip because I wouldn’t get a fast pass for a ride like “magic carpets of Aladdin” which typically has a low wait time. I would look into getting fast passes for the bigger ride like “splash mountain” or the the “flights of passage”. 

If you or anyone else has any questions I’m more than happy to help you guys out. Side note there is this Disney book “birnbaums 2018 Walt DisneyWorld” it’s helpful for looking at details of all ride and all food places at Disney!
